exam_scheme.note: Joint Entrance Examination (Main) Paper 2 is administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission into undergraduate Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch — Paper 2A) and Bachelor of Planning (B.Planning — Paper 2B) courses across National Institutes of Technology (NITs), Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST) Shibpur, and Schools of Planning and Architecture (SPAs Delhi, Bhopal, Vijayawada). For Paper 2A (B.Arch), the examination carries 400 marks with a duration of 180 minutes (3 hours). It comprises three parts: Part I Mathematics (20 MCQs and 10 Numerical Value questions of which 5 are to be attempted, total 100 marks; CBT mode), Part II Aptitude Test (50 MCQs, 200 marks; CBT mode), and Part III Drawing Test (2 questions on drawing sheets, 100 marks; offline pen-and-paper mode). Marking scheme for Parts I & II: 4 marks awarded for correct response, negative marking of 1 mark deducted for incorrect response (-1), and 0 for unattempted questions.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Included in NTA percentile score computation

papers.paper_name: Part II: Aptitude Test (CBT mode: 50 MCQs on visual reasoning, architecture awareness)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Included in NTA percentile score computation

papers.paper_name: Part III: Drawing Test (Offline paper mode: 2 drawing / composition questions)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (evaluated on scale, proportion, shading, perspective)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Evaluated manually; combined with Parts I & II for B.Arch All India Rank
